# Keep focus stable when an edited opportunity leaves a search result

## What & Why
Editing an opportunity can also remove it from a queue because its company, role, or notes no longer match the active search. The status-filter fallback now preserves queue context, but this search-specific path should be verified explicitly.

## Done looks like
- Start editing an opportunity from a search result
- Change the searched company, role, or notes so the result disappears
- Focus returns to a deterministic, accessible queue control
